test_title: PYST 31: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some erasers are pens.

Some pens are bags.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some erasers are bags.

(II) All bags are pens.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25476f4bd7cb54da15a69b69c3840adff54f9a6f7d12464591086914f7082eb0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28afed1a8a90ffb5f73f8395b39dfec80aa14f8e9676a2ee467481addfff3602.png] 

Conclusions:**

 (I) Some erasers are bags → **Does not follow** (There is no direct relation given between erasers and bags. so, it is possible not definite).

(II) All bags are pens →** Does not follow** (As some pen are bags. so, all bags are pens is not true).

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 3**”.
